geeklist.title: CLOSED! 200+ Games for Sale or Trade! Auction Ends 11/9! Plenty of BINS! Ends TODAY approx 6:30 Pac / 9:30 Est!
geeklist.description:
A Big Thank You to the One and Only [user=larryjrice][/user] for use of his auction template.
CONDITION OF GAMES: Unless otherwise stated, all games should be considered opened and played but in good condition. There may be slight shelf wear. As well, unless otherwise noted, all games come from non-smoking home. Exceptions will be noted. Inserts may not be present - I will try to check, but sometimes forget. Ask if you really want to know.
Shipping is from Las Vegas, NV 89139.
RULES OF THE AUCTION:
:d10-1: Auction will end between 5-7 PM Pacific Time on Sunday, November 9th, 2025.
:d10-2: Most games have a BIN. [b]You CAN bid under the reserve amount, but an item won't necessarily sell unless the bidding meets the reserve amount.[/b]
:d10-3: Minimum increase is $1.
:d10-4: BGG will receive 3% commission.
:d10-5: Buyers pay actual shipping costs. All shipping costs will be calculated AFTER the end of the auction via Pirate Ship. I can give an estimate if you list your zip with your bid AND send me a geekmail.
International buyers are welcome, but be aware that international shipping these days is not cheap! I will only use USPS to ship international.
:d10-6: While Zelle or Venmo is preferred. Paypal is also acceptable.
:d10-7: If you are relatively close by and wish to pick up the game from me in person in Las Vegas that can also be arranged.
:d10-8: If you BIN and do not plan to bid on other games; I'm happy to send your games immediately.
:d10-9: GAMES MAY BE REMOVED UPON TRADES AT ANY TIME! [b]I'm always happy to talk trades as well! [/b] Please do check out other geeklist auctions which can be found here: [geeklist=66420]MetaList for GeekList AUCTIONS[/geeklist]
